title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG ENGAGES IN A DIRECT STRUGGLE WITH BAD FORTUNE
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg searches the New York docks for a ship to cross the Atlantic and hires the Henrietta to sail to Bordeaux.
summary_detail: Having missed the steamer for Liverpool, Phileas Fogg and his companions secure lodging in New York. The following day, Fogg scours the docks for a departing vessel and meets Captain Andrew Speedy of the Henrietta. When Speedy steadfastly refuses to sail to Liverpool, Fogg offers him two thousand dollars per passenger to take them to Bordeaux, securing their passage just in time.
